# SaviorBill

> Self-hosted billing platform with Lua extensions, modern Admin UI, and automated client onboarding.

## Overview
SaviorBill is an open-source, self-hosted billing system for digital services, subscriptions, and VPN shops. It features Docker Compose deployment, Lua 5.4 plugins for payment gateways and service provisioners, and a reactive personal account client.

## Documentation
- Quickstart & Installation: https://saviorbill.com/ru/docs/quickstart/
- Lua API Reference: https://saviorbill.com/ru/docs/lua-api/
- Manifest Schema: https://saviorbill.com/ru/docs/lua-manifest/
- Extensions Hub: https://saviorbill.com/ru/hub/

## One-line Installer
Run on a clean Ubuntu or Debian server:
```bash
curl -fsSL https://get.saviorbill.com | bash
```
